title: Heap buffer overflow when attempting to decompress a DXT5 image with non-aligned mipmaps
body:
### Tested versions

current master @ b00e1cbf743dcb6a2b7f6bd14e348a1a7cf3d403

### System information

macOS 14.5.0, M2 Pro, Vulkan

### Issue description

CC @BlueCube3310 , @clayjohn 

related: #97862

Found another one. This one is a bit harder to track down; while users were reporting this happening on Linux and Windows, I was never able to reproduce this on macOS until I built with sanitizers.

The culprit is a DXT5 image of size 384x128 with 8 mipmaps; some of the mipmaps towards the tail-end have dimensions of less than 4x4 pixels (BCDEC_BC3_BLOCK_SIZE is 16), causing misaligned writes and then a crash. I will note that the source image was divisible by 4x4 and did NOT have to be resized.

```
bcdec: Decompressing mipmap 0: 384x128, src_ofs: 0, dst_ofs: 0, target_size: 262144
bcdec: Decompressing mipmap 1: 192x64, src_ofs: 49152, dst_ofs: 196608, target_size: 262144
bcdec: Decompressing mipmap 2: 96x32, src_ofs: 61440, dst_ofs: 245760, target_size: 262144
bcdec: Decompressing mipmap 3: 48x16, src_ofs: 64512, dst_ofs: 258048, target_size: 262144
bcdec: Decompressing mipmap 4: 24x8, src_ofs: 65280, dst_ofs: 261120, target_size: 262144
bcdec: Decompressing mipmap 5: 12x4, src_ofs: 65472, dst_ofs: 261888, target_size: 262144
bcdec: Decompressing mipmap 6: 6x2, src_ofs: 65520, dst_ofs: 262080, target_size: 262144
=================================================================
==52029==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow on address 0x000159984828 at pc 0x000107036d84 bp 0x00016baf46b0 sp 0x00016baf46a8
WRITE of size 4 at 0x000159984828 thread T0
[...]
0x000159984828 is located 8 bytes after 262176-byte region [0x000159944800,0x000159984820)
```

Full log:
[asan.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17642483/asan.log)

MRP is attached below.



### Steps to reproduce

1. Optionally, put the following in modules/bcdec/image_decompress_bcdec.cpp before the call to `decompress_image()`:
```c++
print_verbose(vformat("bcdec: Decompressing mipmap %d: %dx%d, src_ofs: %d, dst_ofs: %d, target_size: %d", i, mipmap_w, mipmap_h, src_ofs, dst_ofs, target_size));
```
2. Build the editor with sanitizers enabled
3. Extract the MRP somewhere.
4. Run the MRP with `<editor_bin> --path <wherever_you_extracted_the_mrp_to> --verbose`
5. Observe crash.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[bcdec-crash-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17642445/bcdec-crash-mrp.zip)
